name: Music Discovery
description: Search for music inside Jellyfin and discover tracks, videos, and playlists.
overview: Adds a discovery layer to Jellyfin's music library, with optional Lidarr requests and streaming companions.

versions.changelog:
- Apply relevance scores to the frontend's camelCase metadata projection.
- Rank cached discovery cards across media-type rows without changing local result order.

- Rank completed discovery cards by title relevance across artist, album, and song rows.
- Leave native Jellyfin card order unchanged.

- Rank cached and new discovery items by title/artist relevance and media type.
- Preserve the original order of all native Jellyfin results.

- Rank appended discovery results by title and artist match strength.
- Preserve the native Jellyfin result order and existing local deduplication.

- Discard discovery metadata/status results superseded by a newer search.
- Position result sections only when Jellyfin's native row order changes.

- Keep native empty headings hidden until local results exist.
- Hide discovery candidates until fully decorated and stop reordering result sections during polling.

- Hide empty native headings immediately and keep them hidden while only discovery candidates are pending.
- Create the discovery row only after candidate metadata and Lidarr status are complete.

- Hide discovery candidates before first paint until metadata and Lidarr status are resolved.
- Hide empty native result rows immediately while preserving populated local rows and Seerr.

- Keep discovery cards hidden until stub metadata and Lidarr status are resolved.
- Add completed discovery cards to their section only after they are fully decorated.

- Keep Jellyfin's native search rows before appended discovery results, regardless of render timing.
- Keep discovery before YouTube and Seerr.

- Preserve Jellyfin native search results unchanged and append only discovery items not already in the library.
- Keep discovery results after local results and before YouTube and Seerr.

- Show local music artists in their own native-style results row.
- Keep missing discovery artists, albums, and tracks visible regardless of Lidarr match, while preserving request-status badges.
- Keep local, discovery, YouTube, and Seerr sections in order.

- Keep local Jellyfin search results visible, including matching local music artists.
- Show missing discovery artists, albums, and tracks regardless of Lidarr match; retain request-status badges.
- Keep results ordered as local, discovery, YouTube, then Seerr.

- Hide Deezer artist results already present in the Jellyfin library while retaining unmatched albums.
- Link discovery albums and tracks to local Jellyfin artist pages when available.
- Preserve native card navigation alongside request controls.

- Hide Deezer artist results already present in the Jellyfin library while keeping missing albums discoverable.
- Preserve native Jellyfin card navigation alongside Lidarr request actions.
- Read Lidarr status fields from both camelCase and PascalCase API responses.

- Show Lidarr match and monitoring state on discovery cards.
- Automatically index Deezer ranks for new library imports in debounced batches.
- Add a popularity-provider status endpoint for dependent clients to gate rank-based features.
- Add top-ranked Deezer tracks endpoint for the artist-balanced Blind Test popularity mode.
- Add an authenticated top-ranked tracks API for Blind Test's Most popular mode.
- Add a resumable manual Deezer popularity index for local tracks, stored in the plugin data folder and exposed through user-scoped rank endpoints.

- Add a setting to hide plugin-generated discovery playlists and skip their background refresh.
- Keep requestable discovery albums in search results instead of adding them to local artist discographies.
- Hide discovery albums and songs that already exist in the Jellyfin music library.
- Replace Play with a centered, type-labeled Request action on non-video discovery cards; YouTube videos retain Play.
- Delay hiding empty native search rows until results have time to render, preventing section flicker.
- Keep the JellyMusicDiscovery and Play from YouTube search sections stable without flicker.
- Put YouTube music videos in a separate Play from YouTube search section after discovery results.
- Hide empty native search sections.
- Group discovery cards in a separate JellyMusicDiscovery section after local results.
- Target Jellyfin 12.1 on .NET 10.
- Intercept synthetic-video playback reports to prevent UserData foreign-key errors.
- Inject request controls into index.html only; leave JavaScript chunks untouched.
